Janusz "Snax" Pogorzelski (born July 5, 1993) is a Polish professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player. He is most known for being part of the Major-winning Polish Virtus.pro squad from January 2014 to June 2018.

After playing for Virtus.pro for nearly six years, interrupted by a short stint in MOUZ, he played for multiple Polish teams before transitioning to the international scene with GamerLegion on September 29th, 2023. On July 3rd, 2024 he joined G2 Esports.

MVPs

[edit]
  • Was named the HLTV MVP of 7 tournaments; including 3 Big Events:
    • Gfinity G3 [7]
    • ESEA Season 18: Global Invite Division [8]
    • ESL ESEA Pro League Invitational [9]
    • CEVO Season 8 Professional [10]
    • StarLadder i-League Invitational #1 [11]

Records

[edit]
  • At 4 years, 5 months and 1 day, Snax, NEO, TaZ, pashaBiceps and byali is the longest-lasting lineup in the history of CS:GO. They played their first game on September 5th, 2013 under ESC Gaming's banner and continued to stay together until February 6th, 2018 when TaZ was benched from Virtus.pro to make way for MICHU.
